description: Canonical feature flag registry: key, default value, operator-facing label, what the flag controls (and what turning it off stops), and how sensitive flipping it is. THIS FILE is the single source of truth. Every surface must carry exactly these keys — no more, no fewer: functions/src/shared/featureFlags-core.ts (mirrored, sync-tested), apps/android/.../config/FeatureFlags.kt (mirrored, sync-tested), and the admin portal's feature-flags page, which reads this file directly so it can never fall behind. Keys are camelCase. Defaults are the fallback when the backend document (or an individual field) is absent, and the initial static backend response. Flag values are backend-managed (admin.setFeatureFlag); clients never persist flag changes locally as authoritative. `sensitivity` drives the admin UI's warning treatment: "safety" = flipping it changes what members are invited to physically drive to and stop at, "privacy" = it governs data collected about members, "standard" = ordinary product surface.

flags.label: Live location
flags.description: Live location sharing and map markers. Off stops live-location sessions being shared or drawn.

flags.label: Event chat
flags.description: Event chat. Off stops sending and reading event chat messages.

flags.label: Kronjakt (hand-placed points)
flags.description: Kronjakt geographic point hunt (hand-placed, admin-approved reward points). Off hides Kronjakt entirely — the hand-placed points and any already-spawned crowns — and stops members being sent to them.

flags.label: Kronjakt automatic spawning
flags.description: Kronjakt AUTOMATIC crown spawning: the scheduled spawner, the aggregate activity signal collected from live-location updates, and crownHunt.claimSpawn. Default OFF — a hand-placed point carries a named admin's safe-location confirmation for that exact spot and an auto-spawned crown cannot, so the automatic engine stays dark until it is deliberately enabled AND admins have approved the areas it may place in (crownSpawnCells, via crownHunt.setSpawnCellApproval). Turning it off stops spawning and stops collecting the activity signal immediately; already-placed crowns still age off the map via the sweep. Independent of crownHunt, so the curated points are unaffected either way.

flags.label: Partners and offers
flags.description: Partner companies and offers. Off hides partner listings and their offers.

flags.label: Partner pass-by statistics
flags.description: Anonymous partner pass-by statistics (requires explicit user opt-in regardless of flag). Off stops partners seeing pass-by statistics.

flags.label: Push notifications
flags.description: Push notification delivery. Off stops all outbound push, including event reminders and moderation notices.

flags.label: External social sharing
flags.description: Sharing content to external social platforms. Off removes the share actions.

flags.label: External data sources
flags.description: Integrations with external data sources (e.g. the road incident feed). Off stops fetching and showing third-party data.

flags.label: Digital billboards
flags.description: Digital billboard content. Off stops serving billboard content to displays and to the app.

flags.label: Partner pass-by recording
flags.description: Anonymous partner pass-by interaction recording (Phase 9j privacy gate). Default OFF; contributions additionally require the user's explicit anonymousPartnerStatsOptIn — the flag alone never enables recording. Off stops recording new pass-by interactions immediately.

flags.label: Kronjakt shop (perks)
flags.description: Kronjakt SHOP — the first member-facing Kronpoäng SINK. On lets members spend Kronpoäng to buy perks (crownHunt.buyPerk), which are granted to a backend-only inventory. Default OFF: the shop stays dark until it is deliberately turned on, and while off buyPerk rejects so no Kronpoäng is spent. Buying is all this flag governs today; deploying and activating perks (traps, shields, the boost multiplier) arrive in later releases behind their own gating.

flags.label: Kronjakt live-share scoring
flags.description: Kronjakt live-share SCORING rule. On, a crown collected while the member is NOT sharing a live session pays only half its Kronpoäng (NON_LIVE_SHARE_MULTIPLIER = 0.5), while a crown collected during an active live session pays full — so live sharing while collecting doubles the points. Fail-open: the halving applies only when the backend can CONFIRM the member is not live-sharing (an active session, or any read error while checking, awards full), so a sharer is never wrongly penalised. Composes multiplicatively with the PvP boost multiplier and applies to BOTH crown award paths (auto-spawn claimSpawn and hand-placed submitClaim). Gates BOTH the backend multiplier AND the Android UI (the instructions line and the crown-tap popup tip), so the UI never describes a rule that is off. Default OFF: while off the multiplier is always 1 and the app shows nothing about it.

flags.label: Report a problem — open-tickets browser
flags.description: In-app 'open tickets' browser on the Report-a-problem page. On lets members read the openTickets Firestore mirror of open public GitHub issues (labelled android-issue, refreshed by the scheduled feedback-syncOpenTickets job) and, once each per issue, +1 or add a comment via feedback.interactWithIssue — the +1 posts a fixed 'Another user is affected by this issue.' comment and a member comment is neutralised, length-bounded, posted to the public repo AND mirrored to the moderationReports admin queue. Default OFF: while off the callable rejects (failed-precondition) so nothing is posted publicly and the client draws no ticket list. Stays dark until the browser UI ships.

flags.label: Chat replies (reply to a message)
flags.description: Inline WhatsApp-style reply-to-message across the chat surfaces (community, convoy, and direct messages). On, the backend snapshots the replied-to message (author + a short text preview) onto the replying message so the quote renders without a lookup and survives the parent expiring, and a reply on the community channel notifies the replied-to author. Default OFF: while off the backend IGNORES any replyToMessageId a client sends (no parent read, no snapshot stored) and the Android reply action stays hidden, so the feature is dark end-to-end. Gates only reply PROCESSING — ordinary messages are unaffected. Message reactions are a separate future feature keyed off the same stable message id.

flags.label: Partner member offers require a paid subscription
flags.description: Gates MEMBER partner offers behind a PAID subscription (Plus or Supporter). On, a free (Community) member sees only the PUBLIC offer teaser plus an upgrade prompt: the member detail (offers/{id}/details/member, gated in firestore.rules on isPaidSubscriber) and the discount code (partners.showOfferCode, gated on requirePaidOrAdminActor) require a paid tier; admins are unaffected. Default OFF and DARK until billing go-live: while off the enforcement is inert and behaviour is exactly as today — the callable falls back to the relaxed member gate (requireMemberActor) and the rules fall back to isActiveMember(), so every authenticated non-suspended user still receives member offers and the app shows the full member content with no upgrade prompt. Keep OFF until the Google Play subscription provider is live and users can actually purchase a paid tier; flipping it on beforehand would lock member offers away from every user with no way to upgrade. Independent of the global member-gating switch.
